messages.text:
BL-957 — Promotion gate never reads depends_on, so a dependent ticket can reach the coder before the work it depends on has landed (20 live candidates)
What it solves: Lineage: extends the BL-663 chokepoint; same file and same epic as BL-854,
which converted orthogonality from a refusal to an advisory. This ticket
moves in the opposite direction — depends_on is declared, per-ticket,
machine-checkable data, unlike the epic tag BL-854 found too coarse to
refuse on.…
Approval context: Two judgement calls are mine, not derived from any existing rule, and both are worth a human ruling before the coder builds.
(1) A dependency counts as satisfied ONLY when it is in backlog/done/. An ACTIVE dependency still refuses. I chose this because it is the standard the coordinator already app…
BL-957 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-957" (or "reject BL-957 <reason>") to act.
